newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Dec S&P 500 ends up after nearing new high.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Dec S&P 500 ends up after nearing new high.

text.p: U.S. December Standard and Poor's 500 futures finished higher after reaching just shy of a fresh contract high on technical momentum from Friday.
Benign inflation data last week and weaker than expected retail sales triggered a rally Friday in Treasury bonds and stock indices, with December S&Ps continuing the strong tone on Monday.

Trading during the day was light to moderate, with December approaching the May 23 contract high at 695.00. Hefty dealer trading on both sides of the market was noted from 693.60 to 694.20, then December retreated into the close.
"We were going for it and going for it, but we just ran out of steam," an S&P 500 futures trader said.
December S&Ps reached a session high of 694.20.

Jim Hyerczyk, president of JAH Trading and Research, said December could spike higher early Tuesday to make the contract high at 695.00, possibly surpass it by 0.05 or 0.10 points, then retreat again.
"The narrower range (on Monday) indicates that there is not a lot of interest here," he said.
He recommended buying a dip in this market, not buying strength.
Another technician said an orderly sell-off to 675.00 to 678.00 would not diminish the bullish picture.
While many said a pullback from these lofty levels was due, others pegged near- and medium-term targets in the low 700.00s.
"This is uncharted territory," an S&P trader said.
Much of the day, Wall Street firms were seen buying December contracts, with one noted firm buying September and December.
"It trades pretty well," another S&P trader said.
He said traders would likely key off private retail sales reports on Tuesday and August industrial production and capacity utilization figures.
August industrial production was forecast up 0.4 percent versus a 0.1 percent gain in July. Capacity was seen at 83.3 percent versus 83.2 percent in July.

December S&P 500s finished up 1.90 pts to 690.75, Value Lines rallied 0.60 to 638.60, Midcap 400s added 0.85 pts to 241.45, NYSE Composite firmed 0.80 to 368.65, and December Nikkei 225 rose 115.0 to 21,145.0. --Derivatives Desk 312-408-8750 E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
